transpilation.note: Metrics are for emitted JavaScript. Type annotations and TS-only syntax are erased; Angular external templates are not part of TS metrics; decorator lowering is used with compiler helpers omitted to reduce helper-code skew. Angular template semantics and type-checking are not measured here.

methodology.aggregate: Sum per-file Halstead volume, cyclomatic complexity, and logical SLOC for the corpus.
methodology.perFunction: Same formula applied to typhonjs-escomplex method metrics; method names are those recovered from emitted JavaScript.
